skyfx.title: SkyFX
skyfx.subtitle: Skies · Glints · Aura
skyfx.option.palette.tooltip: Colour of the Northern Lights sky
skyfx.option.hide_clouds.tooltip: Hides the blocky vanilla clouds while a SkyFX sky is active

skyfx.glint.info1: Glints are applied with a built-in resource pack.
skyfx.glint.info2: Works on every enchanted item, book and armour piece.
skyfx.glint.pending: Textures reload when you press Done.
skyfx.option.aura_style.tooltip: Classic: a coloured fill with a flat edge. Galaxy: the block turns into a window into space.
skyfx.option.item_aura.tooltip: A glowing outline around the item in your hand
